steps.en: Scaffold a project and fill in connection.yaml for your warehouse
steps.zh: 建项目，在 connection.yaml 里填好仓库连接

steps.en: Write a Markdown page with chart tags that name a table and the measures
steps.zh: 写一页 Markdown，用图表标签点名表和指标

steps.en: Each chart tag writes its own SQL in your warehouse's dialect and runs it
steps.zh: 每个图表标签自己生成你仓库方言的 SQL 并执行

steps.en: Ship the project in the official serve image
steps.zh: 用官方 serve 镜像把项目跑起来

steps.en: Re-runs the queries on every page load and serves the report behind Basic Auth
steps.zh: 每次打开页面都重跑查询，在 Basic Auth 后面把报告发给同事

value.en: Reports are text files in git — diffable, reviewable, agent-editable — with live data and no rebuild pipeline
value.zh: 报告就是 git 里的文本文件，能 diff、能评审、能让 agent 改，数据实时，不用维护构建流水线

sources: https://github.com/evidence-dev/evidence/blob/main/docs/migration-guide.mdx (Markdoc line_chart syntax; components write their own SQL; queries re-run on page load)
https://github.com/evidence-dev/evidence/blob/main/docs/self-host/index.mdx (evidencedev/serve image, evidence serve, HTTP Basic Auth)
